### Introduction:

Special thanks to: https://github.com/justmarkham for sharing the dataset and materials.

### Step 1. Import the necessary libraries

```{r step1, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
```

### Step 2. Import the dataset from this [address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guipsamora/pandas_exercises/master/04_Apply/US_Crime_Rates/US_Crime_Rates_1960_2014.csv).

### Step 3. Assign it to a variable called crime.

```{r}
# the same file is also included in this folder: read_csv("US_Crime_Rates_1960_2014.csv")
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guipsamora/pandas_exercises/master/04_Apply/US_Crime_Rates/US_Crime_Rates_1960_2014.csv"
crime <- read_csv(url)
head(crime)
```

### Step 4. What is the type of the columns?

```{r}
glimpse(crime)
```

##### Have you noticed that the type of Year is a number (dbl)? But R has a different type to work with dates. Let's see it now.

### Step 5. Convert the type of the column Year to Date

```{r}
crime <- crime |> mutate(Year = make_date(Year))
glimpse(crime)
```

### Step 6. Set the Year column as the index of the dataframe

```{r}
# tibbles have no index: we keep Year as the first column and sort by it
crime <- crime |>
  relocate(Year) |>
  arrange(Year)
head(crime)
```

### Step 7. Delete the Total column

```{r}
crime <- crime |> select(-Total)
head(crime)
```

### Step 8. Group the year by decades and sum the values

#### Pay attention to the Population column number, summing this column is a mistake

```{r}
crimes <- crime |>
  # floor_date() rounds every date down to the start of its decade
  mutate(Decade = floor_date(Year, "10 years")) |>
  group_by(Decade) |>
  summarise(
    # take the max value only for the "Population" column
    Population = max(Population),
    # and sum every other column
    across(-c(Year, Population), sum)
  )

crimes
```

### Step 9. What is the most dangerous decade to live in the US?

```{r}
# for each column, the decade with the highest value
crimes |>
  pivot_longer(-Decade, names_to = "variable") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  slice_max(value, n = 1) |>
  select(variable, Decade)

# apparently the 90s was a pretty dangerous time in the US
```
